# Epic Core API - Community Port (1.21.1+)

**The original:** Epic Core API by CJiangqiu -- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/epic-core-api) · [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/epic-core-api) · [source](https://github.com/CJiangqiu/EpicCoreAPI)

**Unofficial.** A community-maintained port of **Epic Core API** by **CJiangqiu** to newer versions of NeoForge. It is not made or supported by CJiangqiu: please report problems with this port [on its own issue tracker](https://github.com/jivinstev/EpicCoreAPI/issues), not to the original author.

**Scope:** NeoForge, Minecraft 1.21.1 and newer. Builds are published for Minecraft 1.21.1, 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.8, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3: pick the file for your version.

Published with the original author's permission (https://github.com/CJiangqiu/EpicCoreAPI/issues/9), under the original MIT licence with its copyright notice kept.

## The original

- A library mod that provides powerful entity manipulation APIs through CoreMod (ITransformationService), Java Agent, and Mixin technologies.
- Made for Forge 1.20.1.

## How it differs from the original

- Runs on **NeoForge**, one build per Minecraft version from 1.21.1 to 26.3.
- The CurseForge build doesn't include the original's Java agent.

## Requirements

- Nothing beyond NeoForge for your Minecraft version.

## How releases are made

Every release is built by the original author's own build from https://github.com/jivinstev/EpicCoreAPI, passes automated checks (it builds, loads on a dedicated server, runs in a real client), and is played by a person before it is published here.
